g.text: Oil-temperature gauge front end, option B (filtered). Two copper layers, through-hole parts only. J1 takes the display lead (3.3 V, SDA, SCL,

g.desc: Oil-temperature gauge front end, option B (filtered). Two copper layers, through-hole parts only. J1 takes the display lead (3.3 V, SDA, SCL,

g.text: each paired with a ground); the display runs from its own USB-C socket. J2 takes the sender harness.

g.desc: each paired with a ground); the display runs from its own USB-C socket. J2 takes the sender harness.

g.text: Layout rules: AIN1, AIN2, SENDER and SENSE keep at least 1 mm from ground copper, and there is no

g.desc: Layout rules: AIN1, AIN2, SENDER and SENSE keep at least 1 mm from ground copper, and there is no

g.text: ground pour (a short there gives a believable wrong reading). R1 meets SENDER at J2 pin 1 by its own

g.desc: ground pour (a short there gives a believable wrong reading). R1 meets SENDER at J2 pin 1 by its own

g.text: track. J2 pin 3 is empty, between the sense wire and the return.

g.desc: track. J2 pin 3 is empty, between the sense wire and the return.

g.text: Option B: C1 and C2 go across the pin pairs only, never to ground; C0G, never more than 100 nF.

g.desc: Option B: C1 and C2 go across the pin pairs only, never to ground; C0G, never more than 100 nF.

g.text: Measurement (hardware/WIRING.md): the ADC drives 250 uA out of A0 through Rref and the sender.

g.desc: Measurement (hardware/WIRING.md): the ADC drives 250 uA out of A0 through Rref and the sender.

g.text: Vref = A0 - A1 across Rref, Vs = A1 - A2 across the sender, Rs = Rref x Vs / Vref.

g.desc: Vref = A0 - A1 across Rref, Vs = A1 - A2 across the sender, Rs = Rref x Vs / Vref.

g.text: R1 and R2 tap the sender and the ground-sense wire; at least 2 kOhm between every harness wire and the ADC.
